complete_video_analysis.limitations: Automatic timing may use embedded media clocks; check against real source duration. Catalog labels may be mismatched; prefer actual preview when verified.

scenes.audio: Soft, high-pitched digital chime accompanied by a rhythmic, upbeat electronic synth beat. The tempo is fast and energetic.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A static wide shot of a white 2D digital canvas featuring a graph. The X-axis represents cost per single task from $0 to $3, and the Y-axis represents score from 40% to 80%. A light gray line representing 'GPT-6 Sol' begins to animate, curving upwards from the bottom left corner.

scenes.audio: A series of three 'ding' sound effects corresponding with the appearance of data points on the graph. The electronic synth continues in the background.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The graph continues to populate. A darker black line representing 'GPT-6.1 Sol' appears above the gray line, showing higher performance at lower costs. Both lines advance to the right. The black line peaks sharply at approximately $0.80 and 75.4%, highlighted by a purple glowing node. The gray line remains lower and flatter as it extends toward the $3.00 mark.

scenes.audio: The final 'ding' sound effect echoes as the background electronic music fades out with a sharp digital cut.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: The animation of the lines concludes. The black line plateaus after its peak, ending at a node at approximately $1.50 with a value of 69.0%. The light gray line continues its gradual path toward the right. The background remains clean white with gray grid lines.

provenance.adaptation: Independent per-reference object geometry and complete event program, current AgentEditorial palette. Public demonstration media are replaceable and are not original product evidence.
